name: Foresight
text: Psychic. Once per turn, the bearer's unit can be the target of the Fire Overwatch stratagem for 0 CP. While that unit resolves Fire Overwatch, its attacks hit on an unmodified 4+ if it is within range of an objective marker you control, otherwise on an unmodified 5+.

effect.name: Foresight
effect.text: Fire Overwatch costs 0 CP when used on the bearer's unit.

effect.name: Foresight (hits)
effect.text: The bearer's unit hits on an unmodified 4+ (on an objective marker you control) or 5+ when resolving Fire Overwatch.

name: Eldritch Might
text: Psychic. Each time the bearer makes an attack with a Psychic weapon, you may re-roll a Hit roll of 1, a Wound roll of 1 and a Damage roll of 1.

effect.name: Eldritch Might (hit)
effect.text: The bearer's Psychic weapons re-roll Hit rolls of 1.

effect.name: Eldritch Might (wound)
effect.text: The bearer's Psychic weapons re-roll Wound rolls of 1.

effect.name: Eldritch Might (damage)
effect.text: The bearer's Psychic weapons re-roll Damage rolls of 1.
